I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team. I confirmed the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23, and said I took no action.

One correction to my reply: I wrote "I've updated my notes," but I haven't stored either location anywhere. All I did with each message was acknowledge it in its thread. Gate 47 is the current answer from this conversation, and Dock 23 is no longer right.
